raw_annotations.proposed_function: The asparagine‑rich C‑terminus is prone to aggregation, promoting efficient accumulation of the Lsm1‑7p complex in P‑bodies.
raw_annotations.evidence: Here we show that the Lsm4p subunit and its asparagine-rich C-terminus are prone to aggregation, and that this tendency to aggregate promotes efficient accumulation of Lsm1-7p in P-bodies.

raw_annotations.proposed_function: The asparagine‑rich N‑terminal region is essential for its own localization to P‑bodies in budding yeast.
raw_annotations.evidence: Mazzoni et al. reported that the asparagine-rich N-terminal region of the K. lactis Lsm4 protein, KlLsm4p, which is able to functionally replace its S. cerevisiae homologue, is essential for its own localization to P-bodies in budding yeast.
